## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/PhotoDotPi/Fourier/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the squash-merge commit that drives the release).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests that cover the change (skip for docs/CI-only changes).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `.env.example`, …) where behaviour or configuration changed.
- [ ] I have confirmed this change contains no secrets, tokens, or personal data.
- [ ] This change is my own work, or I have the right to submit it under the project's [AGPL-3.0 licence](https://github.com/PhotoDotPi/Fourier/blob/main/LICENSE).
